}}'''Eadwin''' was a man from [[Far Madding]].

==History==
Eadwin was once [[Verin Mathwin|Verin Mathwin's]] sweetheart.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Eadwin}}  Before she left Far Madding, Verin was engaged to Eadwin. They would have wed had she not journeyed to the [[White Tower]] to become a [[Novice]].
